sourceIntegration: Unmodified upstream git dependency in src/platform/rust/Cargo.toml; default features disabled, gifsicle enabled. One aggregate Rust staticlib.
sharedEncoder: src/services/media/GifEncoder.cpp reuses the existing quality-80 fast infinite-repeat profile and unmodified upstream C ABI. The write callback borrows the already claimed descriptor until gifski_finish joins its writer; it does not use file_output's reopen/unlink behavior. Frames are ordered and input PTS is checked before the upstream denoiser/quantizer. Only OS descriptor write/flush differs in platform FileOutput.cpp.
